@Gideon Sato: your first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in #inc-vtg-hartford: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Guard is writing trailer numbers on a clipboard."

Per the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while the kiosks were down. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
